patch: if np.isfinite(score) and score < best_score: -> if np.isfinite(score) and score <= best_score:

gate.provisional: wall and load1 provisional (box D3-g28, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz)

probe.inputs_tried: a plateau objective (zero on [0,2]^4) with starts 0.5 and 1.5; null: the plateau tilted by 0.01*sum(x); golden winter_typical, summer_negative, flat
probe.direction: the tie goes to the last-scored start instead of the first (x 0.5 -> 1.5); no golden plan moves
probe.metric: the x the multi-start returns when two starts end at distinct points of exactly equal score (the tie the strict < keeps on the first)

should_fail.assertion: a _multi_start_minimize case with two starts ending at distinct x of equal score, asserting the first-scored start's x ships (determinism of the shipped plan under ties)
should_fail.why: the slice's step-4 answer (m4_source) lists it among the closure scripts whose traced baseline executes the line

finding.title: Multi-start's first-wins tie rule (optimizer.py:1994 `<`) is unpinned by the full gate
finding.claim: Turning `score < best_score` into `<=` in _multi_start_minimize makes an exact score tie between two distinct solved starts ship the later one (x 0.5 -> 1.5 on a plateau objective) instead of the first, and GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift stays green; no golden plan reaches a tie.
finding.metric_definition: the x the multi-start returns when two starts end at distinct points of exactly equal score (the tie the strict < keeps on the first)

perturbation.change: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:1994 `if np.isfinite(score) and score < best_score:` -> `if np.isfinite(score) and score <= best_score:`
